Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls

A breach at shipping partner Skladon exposed names, addresses, emails, phone numbers and purchase details for about 27,000 Trezor orders, the company said, and some customers have already reported scam calls. Wallet backups were not involved.

This post Trezor Shipping Partner Breach Exposes 27,000 Orders as Customers Report Scam Calls first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
top_articles.label: BEARISH

Situational Awareness Dumps Bitcoin Miners After Citadel Sale

Situational Awareness, the AI fund run by Leopold Aschenbrenner, cut IREN about 94% and exited Core Scientific, Riot and Hive in the third quarter, leaving $80.8 million in three miner stocks after a July sale to Citadel.
